The '''Jankok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Jankok]], homeworld of the [[Srrors'tok]] species.
